svg.title: Accrued-Service Settlement
svg.desc: BPMN collaboration between a service supplier and Finance, Accounts Payable, and Treasury. A service expense estimate creates an accrual; a later supplier invoice links to it, establishes payable and any excess expense, and proceeds to AP payment.

PurchaseInvoiceLine.AccrualJournalEntryID points to the estimate; GoodsReceiptLineID is absent on this service path. An invoice below estimate may leave a residual accrual.
Later Accrual Adjustment journals use reversal links; they do not have to wait for AP cash payment. Residual-aging reconciliation is a proposed teaching control, not a stored workflow queue.
